record.title: An extension problem for wavelet frames
record.statement:
Assume that $\psi_1,\widetilde\psi_1\in L^2(\mathbb{R})$ and that the wavelet systems $\{2^{j/2}\psi_1(2^j x-k)\}_{j,k\in\mathbb{Z}}$ and $\{2^{j/2}\widetilde\psi_1(2^j x-k)\}_{j,k\in\mathbb{Z}}$ are Bessel sequences in $L^2(\mathbb{R})$. Is it always possible to find functions $\psi_2,\widetilde\psi_2\in L^2(\mathbb{R})$ such that the multi-generated wavelet systems

$\{2^{j/2}\psi_1(2^j x-k)\}_{j,k\in\mathbb{Z}}\cup\{2^{j/2}\psi_2(2^j x-k)\}_{j,k\in\mathbb{Z}}$

and

$\{2^{j/2}\widetilde\psi_1(2^j x-k)\}_{j,k\in\mathbb{Z}}\cup\{2^{j/2}\widetilde\psi_2(2^j x-k)\}_{j,k\in\mathbb{Z}}$

form dual frames for $L^2(\mathbb{R})$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12339), page 69. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Dependence of the confined Willmore minimum on the prescribed area
record.statement:
Let $a>0$, let $B$ be the unit ball in $\\mathbb{R}^{3}$, and let $\mathcal{M}_{a}$ be the class of smoothly embedded surfaces $\Sigma\subset B$ of sphere type with $\operatorname{ar}(\Sigma)=a$. Define
$$
w(a):=\inf_{\Sigma\in\mathcal{M}_{a}}\mathcal{W}(\Sigma),\qquad \mathcal{W}(\Sigma):=\frac14\int_{\Sigma}|\vec H|^{2}\,d\mathcal{H}^{2}.
$$
Determine the dependence of $w(a)$ on the prescribed surface area $a$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/15](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12343), page 63. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Detection of minimized decomposition and inertia groups in pro-\ll Galois groups
record.statement:
Assume that $\ell$ is an odd prime. Let $K$ be a field with $\operatorname{char}K\ne\ell$, let $n$ be a positive integer or $\infty$, and write
\[
G_K=\operatorname{Gal}(K(\ell)/K),\qquad G_K^{a,n}=G_K/[G_K,G_K]\,G_K^{\ell^n},\qquad G_K^{c,n}=G_K/[G_K,[G_K,G_K]]\,G_K^{\ell^n}.
\]
For $\Sigma\le G_K^{a,n}$ and all $N\gg n$, assuming $\mu_{\ell^N}\subset K$, the following are equivalent:

1. There exists a valuation $v$ of $K$ such that $\Sigma\le D_v^n$ and $\Sigma/(\Sigma\cap I_v^n)$ is cyclic.
2. There exists a commuting-liftable subgroup $\Sigma'\le G_K^{a,N}$ whose image under the canonical map $G_K^{a,N}\twoheadrightarrow G_K^{a,n}$ is $\Sigma$.

Moreover, if $n=1$, one may take $N=1$; and if $n\ne\infty$, one can find an explicit finite $N$ that suffices.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/30](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12493), page 37. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Computing genus-2 curves with complex multiplication
record.statement: Let $C$ be a genus $2$ curve over a field $k$ of characteristic $0$, and let $K$ be a totally imaginary quadratic extension of a real quadratic field $F$. We say that $C$ has complex multiplication by $K$ if the maximal order $\d4aa_K$ embeds into the endomorphism ring of the Jacobian $J:=\operatorname{Jac}(C)$. **Problem 1.** Compute all genus $2$ curves over $k$ (up to isomorphism and twists) that have CM by $K$, for example by giving algebraic equations defining them.

record.title: Efficient estimation of integrated volatility with jump activity greater than one
record.statement: Given regularly spaced observations of a one-dimensional Itô semimartingale $X$ on $[0,T]$, estimate the continuous part $C_T$ of its quadratic variation when the jump activity index may exceed $1$. The report considers the structural model $X_t=X_0+\\int_0^t b_s\,ds+\\int_0^t\sigma_s\,dW_s+U_t+V_t$, where $b$ is locally bounded and adapted, $\sigma$ is an Itô semimartingale with locally bounded coefficients, $U$ is a pure-jump Itô semimartingale of activity $r<1$, and $V$ is a finite mixture of stochastic integrals with respect to independent pure-jump symmetric Lévy processes having activity indices $1\leq\beta_M<\cdots<\beta_1$. Construct estimators of $C_T$ attaining rate $1/\sqrt{\Delta_n}$ under these structural assumptions.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/48](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12596), page 30. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Determine the true order of an incomplete exponential sum
record.statement: Let $S(q,a)=\sum_{r=1}^{q}e(ar^k/q)$ and, for odd $k$ with $(a,q)=1$, let $T(q,a)=\sum_{r=1}^{q}(1/2-r/q)e(ar^k/q)$. The report states that $T(q,a)\ll_{\varepsilon}q^{1-1/k+\varepsilon}$ and asks: determine the true order of $T(q,a)$. It also records $T(q,a)=\tfrac12S(q,a)-q^{-1}T^*(q,a)$, where $T^*(q,a)=\sum_{r=1}^{q}r e(ar^k/q)=\tfrac12(q+1)S(q,a)+q\sum_{b=1}^{q}\frac{S(q,a,b)}{1-e(b/q)}$ and $S(q,a,b)=\sum_{r=1}^{q}e((ar^k+br)/q)$.

record.title: Global classical solutions for a four-species reaction–diffusion system in dimensions greater than two
record.statement:
For the four-species reaction–diffusion system
\[
\begin{cases}
\partial_t a_1-d_1\Delta_x a_1=a_3a_4-a_1a_2,\\
\partial_t a_2-d_2\Delta_x a_2=a_3a_4-a_1a_2,\\
\partial_t a_3-d_3\Delta_x a_3=a_1a_2-a_3a_4,\\
\partial_t a_4-d_4\Delta_x a_4=a_1a_2-a_3a_4,
\end{cases}
\]
with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions and positive diffusion coefficients \(d_1,d_2,d_3,d_4>0\), determine whether global classical solutions exist in space dimensions \(N>2\).

record.title: Morphing planar graphs
record.statement: Given two straight-line planar drawings $\Gamma$ and $\Gamma'$ of a planar triangulation $G$ with the outer face fixed, find a planar morph from $\Gamma$ to $\Gamma'$ consisting of a polynomial number of steps, where each step is a planar linear morph. A morph is a continuous family of drawings $\{\Gamma_t\}_{t\in[0,1]}$ with $\Gamma_0=\Gamma$ and $\Gamma_1=\Gamma'$, and it is planar when every $\Gamma_t$ is a straight-line planar drawing; a linear morph moves each vertex along its endpoint line segment at constant speed.

record.title: Revised random-graph bipartite decomposition conjecture
record.statement: For a graph $G=(V,E)$, let $\tau(G)$ be the minimum number of pairwise edge-disjoint complete bipartite subgraphs of $G$ such that every edge of $G$ belongs to exactly one of them. Let $\beta(G)$ be the largest number of vertices in an induced complete bipartite subgraph of $G$. The conjecture is that, for the random graph $G=G(n,0.5)$, $$\tau(G)=n-\beta(G)+1$$ with high probability, where the probability tends to $1$ as $n\to\infty$.

record.title: Minimal conditions for non-Zariski-density of exceptional specializations
record.statement: Let $k$ be a finitely generated field of characteristic $p\ge 0$, let $X$ be a smooth, separated, geometrically connected $k$-scheme, and let $L$ be an infinite set of primes with $p\notin L$. For each $\ell\in L$, let $\rho_\ell:\pi_1(X)\to\mathrm{GL}(H_\ell)$ be a continuous representation, write $G_\ell=\rho_\ell(\pi_1(X))$, and let $\mathcal F_\ell$ be a family of subgroups of $G_\ell$ not containing $G_\ell$. Define $X(\mathcal F_\ell)$ to be the set of closed points $x\in|X|$ for which $G_{\ell,x}$ is contained in some subgroup in $\mathcal F_\ell$. Determine minimal conditions on the representations $\rho_\ell$ and the families $\mathcal F_\ell$, for $\ell\in L$, that ensure $X(\mathcal F_\ell)(k)$ is not Zariski-dense in $X$.

record.title: Genus growth for arithmetic moduli covers
record.statement:
Let $k$ be a finitely generated field of characteristic $p\ge 0$, let $X/k$ be a smooth, separated, geometrically connected curve, and let $L$ be an infinite set of primes with $p\notin L$. For each $\ell\in L$, let $\rho_\ell:\pi_1(X)\to G_\ell\subseteq\mathrm{GL}(H_\ell)$ be a continuous representation, and let $\mathcal F_\ell$ be a family of subgroups $U\subseteq G_\ell$ with $G_\ell\not\subseteq U$. For the connected finite étale covers $X_U\to X$ corresponding to these subgroups, determine minimal conditions on the families $\rho_\ell$ and $\mathcal F_\ell$ that ensure
\[
g_{X\mathcal F_\ell}:=\min\{g_{X_U}:U\in\mathcal F_\ell\}\longrightarrow +\infty\qquad(\ell\in L).
\]

record.title: Bijective interpretation of the map-counting recurrence
record.statement:
Find a bijective interpretation of the displayed recurrence for the numbers $M^g_{i,j}$ of rooted maps of genus $g$ with $i$ vertices and $j$ faces:

$$\frac{n+1}{6}M^g_{i,j}=\frac{2n-1}{3}\left(M^g_{i-1,j}+M^g_{i,j-1}+\frac{(2n-3)(2n-2)}{4}M^{g-1}_{i,j}\right)+\frac12\sum_{\substack{i_1+i_2=i\\ i_1,i_2\ge1}}\sum_{\substack{j_1+j_2=j\\ j_1,j_2\ge1}}\sum_{\substack{g_1+g_2=g\\ g_1,g_2\ge0}}(2n_1-1)(2n_2-1)M^{g_1}_{i_1,j_1}M^{g_2}_{i_2,j_2},$$

for $i,j\ge1$, with $M^g_{i,j}=0$ if $i+j+2g<2$, $M^g_{i,j}=\mathbf{1}_{(i,j)=(1,1)}$ if $i+j+2g=2$, and $n=i+j+2g-2$, $n_1=i_1+j_1+2g_1-1$, and $n_2=i_2+j_2+2g_2-1$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/12](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12872), page 14. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Stanley’s Conjecture 2 on maximum compatible families
record.statement:
For integers $1\le i<j<k\le n$ and $1\le a<b<c\le n$, call $\{i,j,k\}$ and $\{a,b,c\}$ compatible if there exist integers $x_1<x_2<\cdots<x_n$ such that $x_i,x_j,x_k$ and $x_a,x_b,x_c$ are arithmetic progressions. Let $M_n$ be the collection of all subsets $S\subseteq\binom{[n]}{3}$ whose elements are pairwise compatible. Then the number of members of $M_n$ having maximum cardinality is
\[
g(n)=
\begin{cases}
2^{m(m-1)},& n=2m+1,\\
2^{(m-1)(m-2)}(2m-1),& n=2m.
\end{cases}
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/12](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12872), page 62. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Long-time stability of plane waves for the split-step Fourier method
record.statement: For the cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the torus, the split-step Fourier method—Fourier collocation in space combined with Strang splitting in time—can reproduce the long-time orbital stability of plane-wave solutions under small perturbations of the initial value. Besides the assumptions needed for stability of the exact solution, numerical frequencies and numerical resonances must be controlled. For small $m$ in the plane wave $\rho e^{i m\\cdot x}e^{-i\omega t}$, these resonances can be excluded, at least generically, under a CFL-type condition; essentially, the product of the time step $h$ and the largest spatial-semidiscretization frequency must be bounded by $\pi/(2N+1)$. The report states stability over $0\le t_n=nh\le \min(\varepsilon^{-N},h^{-2N})$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12874), page 33. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: The autoregressive filter problem for two variables
record.statement:
Given $c_k=c_{-k}\in\mathbb C$ for $k=(k_1,k_2)\in\Lambda:=\{0,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,\ldots,m\}$, find a polynomial
\[
p(z,w)=\sum_{r=0}^{n}\sum_{s=0}^{m}p_{rs}z^rw^s
\]
such that $p$ has no zeros on the closed bidisk $\overline{\mathbb D}^{\,2}$, where $\mathbb D=\{z\in\mathbb C:|z|<1\}$, and
\[
\widehat{\frac1{|p|^2}}(k):=\frac1{(2\pi)^2}\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^{2\pi}\frac{e^{-ik_1\theta}e^{-ik_2\phi}}{|p(e^{i\theta},e^{i\phi})|^2}\,d\theta\,d\phi=c_k,
\qquad k=(k_1,k_2)\in\Lambda.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/17](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12975), page 37. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Diffusion bridge problem for the Kyle–Glosten–Milgrom models
record.statement:
Suppose that $Z_t=Z_0+\a0\int_0^t\sigma(s)a(Z_s)\,dB_s$ is a diffusion, where $a$ is a sufficiently regular function and $\sigma$ is deterministic. Let $W$ be another Brownian motion independent of $B$. Can one find a function $\alpha:[0,1]\times\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ such that:

1. There exists a strong solution on $[0,1)$ to
   $$Y_t=\int_0^t a(Y_s)\,dB_s^Y+\int_0^t\alpha(s,Y_s,Z_s)\,ds.$$
2. $Y_t=\int_0^t a(Y_s)\,dB_s^Y$, where $B^Y$ is a Brownian motion with respect to the natural filtration of $Y$.
3. $\displaystyle\lim_{t\to1}Y_t=Z_1$.

record.title: Poisson Dixmier–Moeglin equivalence for complex affine Poisson algebras
record.statement: Let $A$ be a finitely generated complex Poisson algebra. Does the Poisson Dixmier–Moeglin equivalence hold for prime Poisson ideals in $A$; that is, do the sets of Poisson rational ideals, Poisson primitive ideals, and Poisson locally closed ideals coincide? Here, a prime Poisson ideal $P$ is Poisson locally closed if it is locally closed in the space of Poisson prime ideals with the induced Zariski topology; it is Poisson rational if the Poisson center of $\\operatorname{Frac}(A/P)$ is exactly $\mathbb{C}$; and it is Poisson primitive if there is a maximal ideal $M\supseteq P$ such that $P$ is the largest Poisson ideal contained in $M$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2014/25](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12983), page 5. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Evolution of complete noncompact warped product manifolds under Ricci flow
record.statement:
Let $N$ be a flat, complete, connected Riemannian manifold of dimension $n\ge 2$. Let $h_0=f_0^2dx^2+g_0^2g_N$ be a complete warped product metric on $\mathbb{R}\times N$ with bounded curvature, where $f_0,g_0:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ are positive. If $h(t)$ is the solution of the Ricci flow
\[
\frac{d}{dt}h(t)(p)=-2\operatorname{Ric}_{h(t)}(p),\qquad h(0)=h_0,
\]
on its maximal interval $[0,T_{\max})$, determine the behavior of $h(t)$.

record.title: Exactness of the p-adic invariant-cycles sequence for coefficients
record.statement:
Let $k$ be a perfect field of characteristic $p>0$, let $W:=W(k)$ be its ring of Witt vectors, and let $K$ be the fraction field of $W$. Let $X$ be a semistable curve over $W$ such that the generic fiber $X_K$ is smooth and the special fiber $X_k$ is a normal-crossing divisor; assume that $X_k$ is connected, has at least two irreducible components, and that all intersection points of its irreducible components are $k$-rational. For an $F$-convergent isocrystal $E$, determine precisely for which coefficients $E$ the sequence

$$H^1_{\mathrm{rig}}(X_k,E)\xrightarrow{i_E^*}H^1_{\log\text{-}\mathrm{cris}}(X_k,E)\xrightarrow{N_E}H^1_{\log\text{-}\mathrm{cris}}(X_k,E)$$

is exact.

record.title: Regular points of Vogel’s plane for the universal adjoint character
record.statement:
Determine the points in Vogel’s plane for which the universal adjoint character
\[
f(x)=\frac{\sinh\!\left(x\frac{\alpha-2t}{4}\right)}{\sinh\!\left(x\frac{\alpha}{4}\right)}\frac{\sinh\!\left(x\frac{\beta-2t}{4}\right)}{\sinh\!\left(x\frac{\beta}{4}\right)}\frac{\sinh\!\left(x\frac{\gamma-2t}{4}\right)}{\sinh\!\left(x\frac{\gamma}{4}\right)},\qquad t=\alpha+\beta+\gamma,
\]
is regular at finite $x$. For the displayed Diophantine family, with $k,n,m\ne -1$, the condition and corresponding Vogel parameters are
\[
knm=kn+nm+km+3n+3k+3m+5,
\]
equivalently
\[
\frac{2}{k+1}+\frac{2}{n+1}+\frac{2}{m+1}=1,
\qquad
\alpha=\frac{2t}{k+1},\quad \beta=\frac{2t}{n+1},\quad \gamma=\frac{2t}{m+1}.
\]

record.title: Correct order of the optimal entropic Ricci-curvature bound for the random transposition model
record.statement:
For the simple random walk on the symmetric group $S_n$ obtained by joining two permutations when they differ by exactly one transposition, with uniform reversible measure $\pi_{RT}(\sigma)=1/n!$, determine the correct order, as $n\to\infty$, of the optimal constant $\kappa_*$ such that the relative entropy is $\kappa_*$-geodesically convex along $W$-geodesics in $(\mathcal P(S_n),W)$. The report establishes the bounds
$$
\frac{4}{n^2-n}\le \kappa_*\le \frac{2}{n-1},

record.title: Cusp formation in the nonlocal transport model
record.statement: For the transport equation $\theta_t(x,t)+u(x,t)\theta_x(x,t)=0$ on $\mathbb{R}\times(0,\infty)$, with $u(x,t)=\int_{\mathbb{R}}|y-x|^{-\gamma}\theta(y,t)\,dy$ for $\gamma\in(0,1)$, and symmetric, nonnegative initial data having its maximum at $x=0$, can one prove that the first singularity is always a cusp, with the solution at the singular time behaving possibly like a square root near the origin? record.title: Lie algebra structure of Hochschild cohomology for a stratifying triangular algebra

record.title: Minimax detection bound for changes in volatility smoothness
record.statement:
Suppose the volatility at time $\theta$ either has a jump of absolute size larger than $b_n$, or its smoothness drops to $a'$ on an interval of length at least $b_n^{1/a}$. For tests $\psi$, let $\gamma_\psi(a,b_n)$ be the sum of the supremum of the type-I error over smooth volatilities and the supremum of the type-II error over the corresponding alternatives. Determine the smallest order of $b_n$ for which
\[
\lim_{n\to\infty}\inf_\psi \gamma_\psi(a,b_n)=0.
\]
The report states that, in both cases, the minimax detection bound is
\[
b_n\sim\left(\frac{n}{\log n}\right)^{-a/(2a+1)}.
\]

record.title: Best constant in the Lieb–Oxford inequality
record.statement:
Determine the best constant in the Lieb–Oxford inequality
\[
E_{\mathrm{Ind}}\ge -C\int_{\mathbb R^3}\rho(x)^{4/3}\,dx,
\]
where \(E_{\mathrm{Ind}}\) is the indirect Coulomb energy associated with an \(N\)-particle symmetric probability distribution on \(\mathbb R^{3N}\), and \(\rho\) is its corresponding density. The report states that this best constant was not yet known and relates the question to the indirect-energy problem at constant density.

record.title: Constrained logarithmic-energy minimization in the Douglas–Kazakov transition
record.statement:
For $T>0$, find the minimum of
\[
I_T(\mu)=\iint -\log|x-y|\,d\mu(x)d\mu(y)+\frac{T}{2}\int x^2\,d\mu(x)
\]
over all Borel probability measures on $\mathbb{R}$ that are absolutely continuous with respect to Lebesgue measure and have density bounded above by $1$. The report states that the constrained minimizer exists and is unique; for $T>\pi^2$ it differs from the unconstrained semicircular minimizer.

record.title: Multicut in bounded-genus graphs with a bounded number of terminals
record.statement: Given an edge-weighted graph embedded on a surface of genus $g$, with $t$ specified terminal vertices and specified terminal pairs, compute a minimum-weight set of edges whose deletion separates the two terminals in every specified pair. record.statement:

record.title: Adaptation of confidence intervals to sparsity in high-dimensional linear regression

record.title: André’s logarithmic Ax–Schanuel theorem for an abelian variety
record.statement: Let $K=\mathbb{C}(S)$ be the function field of an algebraic curve over $\mathbb{C}$, let $A/K$ be an abelian variety with $K/\mathbb{C}$-trace $A_0$, and let $y\in A(K)$. Let $B$ be the smallest abelian subvariety of $A$ such that a nonzero integer multiple of $y$ lies in $B(K)+A_0(\mathbb{C})$. Let $\widetilde A$ be the universal extension of $A$, let $\widetilde y\in\widetilde A(K)$ be any lift of $y$, and let $\widetilde x\in\operatorname{Lie}(\widetilde A)$ be any logarithm of $\widetilde y$. Then $\widetilde x$ generates over $K$ a field of transcendence degree $2\dim(B)$; equivalently, $\operatorname{trdeg}_K K(\widetilde x)=2\dim(B)$。

record.title: Complete characterization of orthogonal multi-wavelet masks
record.statement:
For integers $n\le m$, determine all finite masks $p=\{p_k\}_{k=0}^{s}$ and $q=\{q_k\}_{k=0}^{s}$ with $p_k,q_k\in\mathbb{C}^{m\times m}$ for which there exist square-integrable functions $\phi:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{C}^{n\times m}$ and $\psi=(\psi_1,\ldots,\psi_m)$ satisfying
\[
\phi=\sum_{k=0}^{s}\phi(2\,\cdot-k)p_k,\qquad \psi=\sum_{k=0}^{s}\phi(2\,\cdot-k)q_k,
\]
such that
\[
\left\{2^{j/2}\psi_\ell(2^j\,\cdot-k):j,k\in\mathbb{Z},\ \ell=1,\ldots,m\right\}
\]
is an orthonormal basis of $L_2^n(\mathbb{R})$. The report claims a complete, unified characterization of all such masks via the Unitary Extension Principle and the associated transfer-function realization.

record.title: Low-energy zero-velocity Lieb–Robinson bounds for disordered spin systems
record.statement:
Let $P_E$ denote the spectral projection onto the energy interval $[E_0,E_0+E]$, where $E_0$ is the ground-state energy. Show that there exist constants $C,c,\\mu>0$, $q\ge 0$, and a function $g_E(t)$ such that, for every pair of finite disjoint subsets $X,Y\subset\mathbb{Z}^d$ and observables $A$ and $B$ supported on $X$ and $Y$, respectively, one has, whenever $0\le E\le c\,\operatorname{dist}(X,Y)^q$,
\[
\mathbb{E}\!\left(\left\|\left[\tau_t^\omega\!\left(P_E A P_E\right),B\right]\right\|\right)\le C\,\|A\|\,\|B\|\,|X|\,g_E(t)\,e^{-\mu\operatorname{dist}(X,Y)},\qquad t\in\mathbb{R}.
\]
Here $\mathbb{E}$ is expectation over the disorder and $\tau_t^\omega$ is the Heisenberg dynamics generated by the random Hamiltonian; the desired function $g_E(t)$ should have moderate growth, for example $g_E(t)\sim |t|^\alpha$ for some $\alpha\ge0$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/43](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/14751), page 18. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
